description: Compute the pie-menu for a target object or Sim from your perspective. Prerequisite: you are in a lot with a live local VM (d87-a) and the target is present in that VM (visible in perception.nearby_objects or .nearby_sims). No outbound PDU — this is a local-VM query using VMEntity.GetPieMenu (the same call the perception emitter already exercises at 2048 pie-menus/64 ticks, freesoexperiment-66c); the result is what the UI pie-menu would show if you clicked that target. Effect: returns the list of interactions the engine will accept for interact-with on this target; each entry carries the TTAB id, display name, param0 variant, whether it comes from the callee's GLOBAL TTAB (rare), and ALWAYS a boolean available field and a string[] gates field (freesoexperiment-d51). Every returned entry has available:true and gates:[] — interactions the engine rejected are silently dropped and never appear here. If the engine throws during TTAB evaluation the interactions list contains a single sentinel entry with available:false and gates:["engine-eval-failed"], and the top-level eval_error field carries the exception detail. Cost: one tick-lock acquisition — the computation reads TTAB data and runs CheckAction scripts that the tick thread also mutates, so it is serialized with the tick. Keep queries sparse; for continuous surveillance use the perception stream instead.

args.name: target_object_id
args.description: ObjectID of the target (short). Required if target_sim_id is not set.

args.name: target_sim_id
args.description: PersistID of an avatar (uint). Resolves to that avatar's ObjectID in the local VM. Required if target_object_id is not set.

args.name: include_hidden
args.description: Include interactions flagged HideInteraction/Hidden (normally suppressed from the UI).

args.name: include_global
args.description: Include interactions from the GLOBAL TTAB (applied to every object). Default true — matches stock client behaviour.

call_signatures: cf $CF query-pie-menu --target_object_id <object_id>                                 # discover interactions available on an object
cf $CF query-pie-menu --target_sim_id <persist_id>                                   # discover interactions on another Sim
cf $CF query-pie-menu --target_object_id <id> --include_hidden true                  # include hidden interactions (normally suppressed)
cf $CF query-pie-menu --target_object_id <id> --include_global false                 # exclude GLOBAL TTAB entries
common_mistakes: target_sim_id is a persist_id (resolves to that avatar's ObjectID); target_object_id is a direct ObjectID. Don't cross them up.
Expecting the result to mean 'what will succeed' — Verify() re-runs server-side; an interaction in the pie menu may still fail if server-side preconditions changed between tick and command.
Omitting both target_object_id and target_sim_id → ok:false.
perception_hints: Your own action queue + UIDs (for cancel-interaction): perception.avatar.action_queue[].interaction_id
Dialog prompts (for respond-dialog): perception.recent_events[] where kind=='dialog', look at .extras.dialog_id
refuse_conditions: no VM / no live avatar → ok:false
missing both target_object_id and target_sim_id → ok:false with 'requires target_object_id or target_sim_id'
target_sim_id not in local VM → ok:false with 'sim <id> not in local VM'
target_object_id not in local VM → ok:false with 'object <id> not in local VM'

response_shape.target_object_id: integer — resolved ObjectID of the callee
response_shape.interactions: array of interaction entries; each entry has: id (integer TTAB index), name (string), param0 (integer), global (boolean), score (float), available (boolean — ALWAYS present, NEVER null; true for all normally returned entries), gates (string array — ALWAYS present, NEVER null; empty [] for normal entries, ["engine-eval-failed"] when the engine threw during TTAB evaluation)
response_shape.eval_error: string — only present when interactions contains the engine-eval-failed sentinel; carries the exception type and message for diagnostics
